title: Externalize Pantheon LEAN extensions and validate the execution dependency baseline
summary: Externalized Pantheon LEAN extensions from the fork into an external local library at integrations/lean/pantheon_algo, pinned upstream LEAN master commit 23b735d99a357807dc0df9f4c51d30f05fe0d277 and Docker image quantconnect/lean:18070, updated .gitmodules to retire the fork submodule without losing git history, and resolved the execution/broker dependency baseline (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, shioaji, jsonschema, redis, asyncpg) with pinned lockfiles under dependencies/locks/. Validated runtime context, engine replay, restart contracts, and broker facade simulation with 114 passing tests.

not_changing: live broker credentials or production accounts (strictly zero live orders)
capital allocation limits or risk policy decisions
control plane specs or BFF routing

review_decision.note: Independently verify: (1) externalized library at integrations/lean/pantheon_algo provides PantheonAlgoBase, smoke_loader_test, and tests; (2) .gitmodules points to upstream QuantConnect/Lean.git; (3) lean submodule is pinned to upstream commit 23b735d99a357807dc0df9f4c51d30f05fe0d277; (4) lockfiles exist at dependencies/locks/services-broker.txt, dependencies/locks/services-broker-sinopac.txt, and dependencies/locks/services-execution-lean_runtime.txt with clean pip install; (5) all 114 unit/contract tests and smoke_test_lean_algo.py pass cleanly; (6) live broker flag and credentials are fully protected.
